<description>
An orphan that enters the mempool other than through peer relay (e.g. by RPC) stays in the orphanage, so Find1P1CPackage can pick it as the child of a reconsiderable parent, and package evaluation then reports it as MEMPOOL_ENTRY, which hit Assume(false). Treat it as accepted instead.

The alternative would be to clean the orphanage on mempool accept, but the `Assume()` removed here would still be invalid, as it would be done on the background thread.

Or for now just remove the `Assume()` and note that it's currently possible?
</description>
